skill.name: agentdb-memory-patterns
skill.description: Guide AI agent builders through persistent memory patterns with AgentDB, including session memory, long-term facts, pattern learning, and ReasoningBank migration.
skill.summary: Build persistent AI agent memory with AgentDB patterns and CLI workflows.
skill.author: DNYoussef

security_audit.summary: Most static Ruby backtick detections are Markdown fences, TypeScript snippets, or template literals and are false positives. Confirmed issues remain where the skill instructs users to run unpinned npx commands, register an MCP server, and handle memory database exports or migrations. No prompt injection or malicious exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Unpinned npx commands use agentdb@latest throughout the examples.
remediation.suggestion: Pin AgentDB to a reviewed version and instruct agents to request user approval before running CLI commands.

remediation.issue: The MCP setup registers an external server command with Claude Code.
remediation.suggestion: Add trust-boundary guidance, permission review steps, and version pinning before MCP registration.

remediation.issue: Memory database exports and migrations may copy sensitive agent memory.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users that database files and backups may contain personal data and must be stored securely.

remediation.issue: Persistent memory examples omit privacy lifecycle controls.
remediation.suggestion: Document consent, retention, deletion, encryption, and audit practices for conversation and preference memory.

content.value_statement: Stateful agents need reliable memory across sessions and tools. This skill gives AgentDB patterns for storing, retrieving, migrating, and optimizing agent memory.
actual_capabilities: Shows AgentDB CLI setup commands for local memory databases.
Provides TypeScript examples for session memory and long-term facts.
Explains pattern learning, hierarchical memory, and memory consolidation.
Documents query, import, export, stats, and benchmark workflows.
Describes ReasoningBank migration and AgentDB adapter usage.
Lists learning plugin templates and reasoning agent modules.
limitations: The skill is documentation only and does not ship executable source files.
It depends on external AgentDB and agentic-flow packages.
Examples use unpinned latest package commands unless users change them.
Privacy, encryption, deletion, and retention controls need separate design.

use_cases.title: Add Session Memory
use_cases.description: Design message history storage and retrieval for a stateful chat agent.

use_cases.title: Configure Claude Code Memory Tools
use_cases.description: Connect an AgentDB MCP server so Claude Code can use persistent memory workflows.

use_cases.title: Migrate ReasoningBank Data
use_cases.description: Plan a migration from legacy ReasoningBank storage into AgentDB-backed memory.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Basic Session Memory
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a chat agent.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design session memory for a chat agent. Include stored fields, retrieval limits, and failure handling.

prompt_templates.title: Design Long-Term Facts
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to define long-term user facts for my assistant. Include categories, confidence rules, and update behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Build Pattern Learning Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a pattern learning workflow. Include triggers, success metrics, consolidation timing, and retrieval strategy.

prompt_templates.title: Review Memory Migration Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review my ReasoningBank migration plan. Identify data risks, validation steps, rollback steps, and performance checks.

output_examples.input: Design session memory for a support chatbot.
output_examples.output: A memory plan with stored message fields, session filters, retrieval limits, and retention notes.

output_examples.input: Plan long-term preference storage for a coding assistant.
output_examples.output: A fact model with categories, confidence levels, source tracking, and update rules for user preferences.

output_examples.input: Prepare a ReasoningBank to AgentDB migration review.
output_examples.output: A migration checklist covering backups, validation, sensitive memory handling, rollback, and performance checks.

best_practices: Pin AgentDB package versions before running CLI or MCP commands.
Treat memory databases and exports as sensitive user data.
Define retention, deletion, and consent rules before storing conversations.
anti_patterns: Do not run latest package commands automatically without user approval.
Do not export memory backups into shared or public folders.
Do not store private user facts without clear purpose and retention rules.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps design persistent memory for AI agents using AgentDB, local databases, and ReasoningBank patterns.

faq.question: Does the skill include runnable application code?
faq.answer: No. It provides documentation, CLI examples, and TypeScript patterns that users adapt to their projects.

faq.question: Can it work with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents an AgentDB MCP server workflow for Claude Code integration.

faq.question: What data can AgentDB memory contain?
faq.answer: It can contain conversation history, user preferences, learned patterns, embeddings, and migrated agent memory.

faq.question: What should users verify before using it?
faq.answer: Users should verify package versions, MCP permissions, data retention policy, and backup storage controls.

faq.question: Is it suitable for production memory systems?
faq.answer: It can guide production designs, but teams must add privacy, security, monitoring, and operational controls.
